digestMethod: SHA256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the ordered document name/sha256 pairs, without size or text fields.
runtimeAuthority: This file is a public index, not runtime trust input. The main-process reader compiles its own fixed allowlist, byte sizes, and raw-byte SHA256 values. Renderer and content-pack paths cannot select knowledge files.
packBinding: The main Mission service checks the active pack identity and compatible version before admitting this app-owned knowledge binding. This index does not grant tools or runtime permissions.
hashScope: Document SHA256 values below hash the raw bytes of public distilled documents. They are not the private-source SHA256 values recorded inside sources.json, and they do not publish or locate private source files.
evidenceBoundary: Knowledge loading is a verified document read, not CAD execution or acceptance. Saved case results retain their recorded version and scope. This binding does not reopen native CAD, re-export STEP, validate a new design, perform physical tests, or authorize manufacturing release.
